reviews.title: Better than 13 and 14 gen
reviews.comment: This 12900 is a great CPU for daily use and gaming. I tried 13900 and 14900 - they run unstable and keep heat throttling, even with 360 water cooling. No need to power limit 12900 and it just runs everything.
reviews.author: Nick

reviews.title: Great CPU
reviews.comment: Got the i9 to go in my new rig. First time building from scratch. The manufacturer's install nstructions didn't mention that the base bracket goes underneath the MB. I thought it was just there to protect the cooler during shipment. Nothing to do with the seller.  But thank goodness I didn't throw it out. Once I figured that out, the install went smooth and Mobo recognized the cpu and stock cooler. Cpu and cooler arrived on time and good packaging. No complaints.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Great Intel CPU
reviews.comment: Easy to install. Comes with a CPU cooler, but we chose a more robust cooler.
